title: Ontario municipal systems that convert housing targets into completed units
question: Which municipal systems can convert housing targets into completed units?
why_it_matters: Provincial targets and housing demand matter only if municipal planning, servicing, approvals, infrastructure, labor, and financing can convert them into occupied homes.
current_support: FTFN has Ontario housing supply progress, CMHC and Statistics Canada data, a June 2026 CMHC stage baseline for approved-but-not-started units, active construction, completions, and starts in the Toronto CMA, Toronto application 24 254930 from notice through staff report and Scarborough Community Council recommendation, a dated July 29-31 Council gate with explicit bill-withholding conditions, Toronto's 2025 Development Pipeline, Toronto Water's adopted 2026-2035 capital plan, IESO's 2026 electricity outlook, and Toronto Hydro's OEB distribution proceeding.
missing_evidence: final servicing conditions and detailed design
City Council disposition and enacted by-laws for application 24 254930
satisfaction of the wind-study, land-exchange, and laneway conditions
project-specific infrastructure funding and utility connections
stage conversion and completions by municipality
candidate_records: Toronto application 24 254930 City Council decision and enacted by-laws
next_action: Use the current CMHC stage baseline as aggregate context only. Recheck application 24 254930 after the July 29-31 Council meeting for the disposition, amended recommendations, bill status and enacted by-laws, then track condition compliance, building permits, financing, start, completion, and occupancy.

named_records: CMHC June 2026 Housing Starts And Construction Data
Toronto City Council item 2026.SC33.9 for application 24 254930
latest_review.stage_result: CMHC now supplies a current Toronto CMA baseline across approved-but-not-started units, active construction, completions, monthly starts, and year-to-date starts. The aggregate stage evidence improves the municipal conversion context but cannot be joined to the selected application, whose Council stage remains scheduled for July 29-31.
latest_review.stop_rule: Do not treat metropolitan stocks and flows as a same-project conversion rate or infer the selected application's outcome. Hold the project trail until the official Council item posts a disposition, bills, by-laws, or changed conditions.

notes: Phase 55Q adds current aggregate conversion-stage evidence while preserving the application-level date gate. Citywide and CMA measures do not prove Council adoption, enacted by-laws, condition compliance, project utility connections, a building permit, financing, construction, completion, or occupancy.
